notes: Synthesized for lane CA-V6 from CloudSessionRecord (dist/cloud/api.d.ts) and CloudSessionApi.listWithToken (dist/cloud/index.js: the client reads response.data); shape confirmed live 2026-11-02 (one free-account session, api.cline.bot), values synthesized. Live: the envelope also carries success, and a record also carries userId, sandboxId, origin and historyUrl (never decoded); these are not in the type and are graded Inferred (the corpus has no live grade). metadata.handoff.sourceSessionId is read by the compiled client (dist/cloud/index.js) but is not in the type, so it is Inferred. Observed in vendor client, undocumented: api.cline.bot's session API has no published reference; the shape is read from the vendor's own client and can change without notice.
